_what: The words and settings of the layer diagram's typed graph contract (graph-contract.mjs): the document version it reads, the id shape, the most it accepts (derived once, so a document that validates always draws), the change states every node and edge says, which look each change state and each kind wears, the kinds a node and an edge may name, what an unknown kind does, the fields a document may never carry (positions), and the words each refusal is said in. Every list here is DATA: add a kind, a change state or a limit by editing this file; nothing in code names one.

errors.WRONG_TYPE: {path} has the wrong type: {expected} was expected.
errors.BAD_ID: {path} is not a valid id: use lower-case letters, digits and . _ : - (at most 64 characters).
errors.UNSUPPORTED_VERSION: {path} is version {found}; this reader draws versions {oldest} to {newest}.
errors.MISSING_DELTA: {path} must say its change state: one of {states}.
errors.INVALID_DELTA: {path} names the change state "{found}"; the change states are {states}.
errors.UNKNOWN_KIND: {path} names the kind "{found}"; it is drawn plain.
errors.REFUSED_KIND: {path} names the kind "{found}", which is not one of {kinds}.
errors.POSITION_NOT_ALLOWED: {path} gives a position or size; a document says what and how connected, never where. Use min_height for a floor.
errors.BAD_FLOOR: {path} must be a whole number from 0 to {most}.
errors.EMPTY_GRAPH: {path} must contain at least one node.
errors.DUPLICATE_ID: {path} repeats the id "{found}", first used at {first}.
errors.BROKEN_REFERENCE: {path} points to "{found}", which no node declares.

words.refusal_fallback: This part of the graph does not follow the graph rules.
